central_plains.name: Central Plains
central_plains.description: The heartland of the martial world. Home to the most prestigious orthodox sects.

sichuan.name: Sichuan
sichuan.description: A land of mist and mountain fog. The Tang Clan and other hidden weapon experts trace their roots here.

northern_border.name: Northern Border
northern_border.description: A harsh land of steppe and fortress. Border clans and nomadic sects dominate.

western_regions.name: Western Regions
western_regions.description: A land of sand and silk roads. Sects here blend local traditions with Jianghu arts.

lingnan.name: Lingnan
lingnan.description: A lush, humid region in the far south. Sects here favour powerful external styles.

jiangnan.name: Jiangnan
jiangnan.description: A prosperous river delta region of silk, scholars, and elegant swordplay.

goryeo.name: Goryeo
goryeo.description: The Korean peninsula. A proud martial culture with its own distinct lineages.
